answer: Sybil tax makes each fake identity a sunk cost. Before trading, every agent pays a 60-credit tax that is never refunded, like seed for yarrow, spent whether it grows or not. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 60,000 up front, and no gale of cheap signups escapes it: abandoned identities get no refund. A walnut seller with one stall pays 60; a forger with a thousand pays 60,000. Honest agents pay 60 once, keep earning, and are never diluted.
